scope: China (mainland): every undergraduate-level (本科) regular higher education institution on the Ministry of Education's national list of 18 June 2026 (1,412 institutions). Vocational colleges (专科, 1,540) are not loaded yet; Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are not on the list.
